results.name: Duplicate + Delayed Event
results.input_conditions: Event delayed 15 minutes past nominal transmission followed by immediate retransmission.
results.expected_behavior: First delayed event ingested; duplicate retransmission detected and ignored.
results.privacy_safety_guarantee: Prevents double-alert generation and counter inflation.

results.name: Out-of-Order + Stale Telemetry
results.input_conditions: Newer telemetry arrives first; older packet arrives out-of-order.
results.expected_behavior: Both ingested safely without time sequence corruption or database crash.
results.actual_behavior: Both signals ingested; timestamps preserved for historical sequence sorting.
results.privacy_safety_guarantee: Historical timeline consistency maintained across out-of-order deliveries.

results.name: Missing Required Field + Malformed Payload
results.input_conditions: Payload with missing recipient identifier followed by unsupported signal type.
results.expected_behavior: Both payloads rejected at ingestion boundary with safe validation errors.
results.actual_behavior: Payload 1 errors: ["Missing required field: 'care_recipient_id' (or 'recipient_id'/'patient_id')"]; Payload 2 status: rejected_invalid_payload.
results.privacy_safety_guarantee: Malformed edge data never propagates to rules engine or caregiver views.

results.name: Sensor Drift + High-Frequency Noise
results.input_conditions: Single-sample spike (+40 units) followed by persistent baseline shift (>15%).
results.expected_behavior: Spike smoothed by EMA filter; persistent baseline divergence flags drift advisory.
results.actual_behavior: Noise spike smoothed to 64.0; Drift detected: True.
results.privacy_safety_guarantee: Transient hardware noise does not trigger false caregiver panic.

results.name: Network Interruption + Packet Burst (Data Storm)
results.input_conditions: 100 telemetry packets delivered in a single rapid burst.
results.expected_behavior: All 100 packets normalized, deduplicated, and processed without dropping data.
results.privacy_safety_guarantee: System remains responsive under packet backlog recovery.

results.name: Multiple Simultaneous Anomalies
results.input_conditions: Simultaneous missed check-in and device heartbeat gap.
results.expected_behavior: Generates distinct, explainable operational alerts; does NOT combine into synthetic diagnosis.
results.actual_behavior: Generated 6 distinct alerts; all strictly passed non-medical linter.
results.privacy_safety_guarantee: Preserves strict non-medical boundary under compound event conditions.

results.name: Consent Restriction + Alert Generation
results.input_conditions: High-severity medication alert dispatched to Neighbor caregiver with Tier 0 (withheld) consent.
results.expected_behavior: Notification dispatch withheld at dispatcher boundary; 0 private data transmitted.
results.privacy_safety_guarantee: Backend consent boundary strictly enforced before external notification dispatch.

results.name: Sensor Data Gap + Subsequent Recovery
results.input_conditions: 8-hour missing heartbeat generates system alert; fresh heartbeat arrives 5 minutes ago.
results.expected_behavior: Data gap correctly fired as system status, then automatically cleared upon telemetry arrival.
results.actual_behavior: Gap fired: True; Recovery cleared alert: True.
results.privacy_safety_guarantee: System alerts distinguish operational hardware status from resident wellbeing.
